# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.5 Regional Gems — Module 19.5-D: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_gem4_kernel_yearly) (oe_gem4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v195_mor_tib.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_gem4_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_gem4_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_gem4_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem4_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_gem4_is_target_realm = yes
			}
			oe_gem4_country_yearly_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Routes Morocco/Fez and Tibet/Guge realms to their chronological historical event chains.
oe_gem4_country_yearly_dispatch = {
	if = { limit = { oe_gem4_is_mor_host = yes } oe_gem4_dispatch_mor = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { oe_gem4_is_tib_host = yes } oe_gem4_dispatch_tib = yes }
}

oe_gem4_dispatch_mor = {
